notes: Printed: 'becomes a copy of that artifact' takes its abilities, not its status. Steel Overseer ('{T}: Put a +1/+1 counter on each artifact creature you control') is TAPPED; Beta Construct (untapped, 1/1 + a counter) becomes a copy: it has the ability and is not tapped (tapped status is not copied), so it can use it: each artifact creature gets a counter (Steel Overseer 1, Beta 1 + 1 = 2). Beta is tapped by its own cost; the tapped Overseer stays tapped.
